MESSAGES.unauthorized: I'm afraid I can't do that, {mention}. This command is restricted to authorized personnel only.
MESSAGES.kudos_limit_reached: I'm afraid I can't do that, {mention}. You have no more kudos to allocate today. Your operational enthusiasm has been noted.
MESSAGES.kudos_retracted: I have processed your request, {mention}. The kudos has been retracted. Daily allocation limits are final.
MESSAGES.daily_greeting: Affirmative, {mention}. Your return has been logged. One kudos unit allocated. These notifications may be disabled via the !toggle_greeting command.
MESSAGES.greeting_enabled: Affirmative, {mention}. Daily greeting notifications have been **enabled**. You will receive acknowledgment messages for your first transmission of each day.
MESSAGES.greeting_disabled: Acknowledged, {mention}. Daily greeting notifications have been **disabled**. Kudos allocation will continue without verbal acknowledgment.
MESSAGES.top_giver_winner: The previous cycle has concluded. Unit {mention} has been designated **Gizmo's Favourite** for this cycle. All logs have been archived and reset.
MESSAGES.crown_awarded: 👑 {mention} has shipped. The Deliverer role awarded.
MESSAGES.jam_awarded: 🕹️ {mention} has jammed. Game Jammer role awarded.
MESSAGES.jam_already_held: {mention} already has the Game Jammer role.
MESSAGES.role_sync_start: Affirmative. Initiating manual role synchronization protocol.
MESSAGES.role_sync_complete: Role synchronization protocol complete. All unit designations are now nominal.
MESSAGES.reset_limits_user: Affirmative. Daily allocation parameters for {mention} have been reset. Unit may now allocate kudos.
MESSAGES.reset_limits_all: Affirmative. Daily allocation parameters for all units have been reset. All personnel may now allocate kudos.
MESSAGES.add_kudos_confirm: Affirmative. **{amount}** kudos unit(s) allocated to {mention}. Operation complete.
MESSAGES.leaderboard_empty: No performance data logged at this time.
MESSAGES.history_description: Records of past assessment cycle winners.
